records.jp: へー、こんな道具もあるんだ
records.en_original: Wow, there's all kinds of tools in here.
records.en_auxiliary: Wow, there's all kinds of tools in here.
records.en: Wow, there's all kinds of tools in here.

records.jp: あ、これいいじゃん。<CR>次使おう
records.en_original: Oh, this looks handy. I'll use it next time.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, this looks handy. I'll use it next time.
records.en: Oh, this looks handy. I'll use<CR>it next time.

records.jp: 楽しそうだね
records.en_original: You look like you're having fun.
records.en_auxiliary: You look like you're having fun.
records.en: You look like you're having fun.

records.jp: え？　そう？
records.en_original: Huh? Really?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Really?
records.en: Huh? Really?

records.jp: なんかイキイキしてるっていうか
records.en_original: Yeah, I can feel the excitement coming off of you.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, I can feel the excitement coming off of you.
records.en: You seem unusually lively, somehow.

records.jp: こういうもの触るの好きなんだよね。<CR>へー、こんなことできるんだって一通り試したくなる
records.en_original: I like fiddling with things like this. I want to try everything! I'm always like "oh, it can do this too?"
records.en_auxiliary: I like fiddling with things like this. I want to try everything! I'm always like "oh, it can do this too?"
records.en: I like fiddling with things like this.<CR>I want to try everything! I'm always like "oh, it can do this too?"

records.jp: お、はんだごてある。<CR>これも一回は使ってみたかったんだよね～
records.en_original: Ooh, a soldering iron. I've always wanted to use one of these.
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh, a soldering iron. I've always wanted to use one of these.
records.en: Ooh, a soldering iron.<CR>I've always wanted to use one of these.

records.jp: （こんな気力に満ち溢れた伶那さん、初めて見た）
records.en_original: (This is the first time I've seen Rena so enthusiastic about something.)
records.en_auxiliary: (This is the first time I've seen Rena so enthusiastic about something.)
records.en: (This is the first time I've seen Rena-san so enthusiastic about something.)

records.jp: かっこいい
records.en_original: You're so cool.
records.en_auxiliary: You're so cool.
records.en: You're so cool.

records.jp: どこが？
records.en_original: What are you talking about?
records.en_auxiliary: What are you talking about?
records.en: What are you talking about?

records.jp: ド文系の私からすると、こういうのをパッと見て<CR>興味持てる時点で羨ましい
records.en_original: I've always been more of an arts person, so I envy people who are good with this kind of stuff.
records.en_auxiliary: I've always been more of an arts person, so I envy people who are good with this kind of stuff.
records.en: As someone completely on the humanities side,<CR>I envy you just for being able to look at these and immediately take an interest.

records.jp: そ、そういうもの？<CR>私にはこれが普通だったから、よくわからないんだけど
records.en_original: What? Really? I'm just doing what comes naturally to me.
records.en_auxiliary: What? Really? I'm just doing what comes naturally to me.
records.en: What? Really?<CR>I'm just doing what comes naturally to me.

records.jp: そう言う星崎さんは、何か使ってみたいものないの？
records.en_original: So, is there anything you want to try to use, Hoshizaki?
records.en_auxiliary: So, is there anything you want to try to use, Hoshizaki?
records.en: So, is there anything you want to try to use, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: さっき塗料見つけたんだけど、<CR>すごくちょうどよさそうだった
records.en_original: I saw some paint that looked perfect.
records.en_auxiliary: I saw some paint that looked perfect.
records.en: I saw some paint<CR>that looked perfect.

records.jp: 何に？
records.en_original: For what?
records.en_auxiliary: For what?
records.en: For what?

records.jp: ガレキの塗装
records.en_original: For the model kit.
records.en_auxiliary: For the model kit.
records.en: Painting a garage kit.

records.jp: あ、ガレキっていうのはガレージキットの略で……
records.en_original: You know, those plastic figures that you put together yourself?
records.en_auxiliary: You know, those plastic figures that you put together yourself?
records.en: Ah, “garage kit” is what “gareki” is short for...

records.jp: 実はこの前、物置きの掃除してた時に<CR>見つけたんだよね。未塗装のやつ
records.en_original: I found one when we were cleaning out the storage space earlier.
records.en_auxiliary: I found one when we were cleaning out the storage space earlier.
records.en: I found one when we were cleaning<CR>out the storage space earlier.

records.jp: 失敗するのが怖くて箱から出してなかったんだけど、<CR>これを機に塗っちゃおうかな～
records.en_original: I haven't started on it because I was afraid of messing it up, but maybe I'll take this opportunity to paint it.
records.en_auxiliary: I haven't started on it because I was afraid of messing it up, but maybe I'll take this opportunity to paint it.
records.en: I haven't started on it because I was afraid of messing it up, but maybe<CR>I'll take this opportunity to paint it.

records.jp: ……ヤスリがけは丁寧にした方がいい
records.en_original: Make sure you file those edges down carefully.
records.en_auxiliary: Make sure you file those edges down carefully.
records.en: ...You should sand it carefully.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: なんでもない！
records.en_original: Nothing!
records.en_auxiliary: Nothing!
records.en: Nothing!

records.jp: ニッパーとか
records.en_original: The wire cutters.
records.en_auxiliary: The wire cutters.
records.en: The wire cutters, maybe.

records.jp: 何用？
records.en_original: What for?
records.en_auxiliary: What for?
records.en: What for?

records.jp: 爪切り用
records.en_original: To cut my nails.
records.en_auxiliary: To cut my nails.
records.en: For cutting my nails.

records.jp: 爪切り！？
records.en_original: To cut your nails?!
records.en_auxiliary: To cut your nails?!
records.en: To cut your nails?!

records.jp: うん。力を入れやすいから、切りやすいし。<CR>爪に負担がかかりにくいから、仕上がりも綺麗だし
records.en_original: Yeah. They cut easily, so it wouldn't be hard on the nails, and the cut would be really clean.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. They cut easily, so it wouldn't be hard on the nails, and the cut would be really clean.
records.en: Yes. They are easy to put force into, so they cut well.<CR>They put less strain on the nail too, so the finish is clean.

records.jp: ふーん……
records.en_original: Huh...
records.en_auxiliary: Huh...
records.en: Huh...

records.jp: いや、だとしても、工具用の普通のニッパーを<CR>そんな使い方して大丈夫なの？
records.en_original: Even so, are you sure that's a safe use of a tool made for cutting wires?
records.en_auxiliary: Even so, are you sure that's a safe use of a tool made for cutting wires?
records.en: Even so, is it safe to use ordinary tool nippers<CR>for something like that?

records.jp: 大は小を兼ねる的な
records.en_original: Go big or go home, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Go big or go home, right?
records.en: Something like “the large can serve for the small.”

records.jp: それ、そういう時に使う言葉じゃないと思うんだけど
records.en_original: That's...not exactly the phrase I would use here.
records.en_auxiliary: That's...not exactly the phrase I would use here.
records.en: That's...not exactly the phrase I would use here.

records.jp: 伶那さんは、これ作ってみたいとかあるの？
records.en_original: Is there anything you want to make, Rena?
records.en_auxiliary: Is there anything you want to make, Rena?
records.en: Is there anything you want to make, Rena-san?

records.jp: いつか作ってみたいってものならある
records.en_original: There is one thing I've always wanted to try and make.
records.en_auxiliary: There is one thing I've always wanted to try and make.
records.en: There is one thing I've always wanted to try and make.

records.jp: 何？
records.en_original: What's that?
records.en_auxiliary: What's that?
records.en: What's that?

records.jp: ロボット
records.en_original: A robot.
records.en_auxiliary: A robot.
records.en: A robot.

records.jp: おお！　どういうやつ？
records.en_original: Ooh! What kind of robot?
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh! What kind of robot?
records.en: Ooh! What kind of robot?

records.jp: まだ決めてない。<CR>ただ漠然と作ってみたいなって考えてるだけ
records.en_original: I don't know yet. I've just always wanted to make a robot.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know yet. I've just always wanted to make a robot.
records.en: I don't know yet.<CR>I've just always wanted to make a robot.

records.jp: 星崎さんは、どんなロボがあったらいいと思う？
records.en_original: What kind of robot would you want, Hoshizaki?
records.en_auxiliary: What kind of robot would you want, Hoshizaki?
records.en: What kind of robot would you want, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: お手伝いロボかな
records.en_original: A helper robot, maybe.
records.en_auxiliary: A helper robot, maybe.
records.en: A helper robot, maybe.

records.jp: すごくあなたらしいと思う
records.en_original: I knew you'd say that.
records.en_auxiliary: I knew you'd say that.
records.en: I knew you'd say that.

records.jp: 実際よくない？　日々の雑務から解放されたくない？
records.en_original: Wouldn't it be nice though? You'd never have to do chores again.
records.en_auxiliary: Wouldn't it be nice though? You'd never have to do chores again.
records.en: Wouldn't it be nice though? You'd never have to do chores again.

records.jp: あなた言うほど雑務してないでしょ
records.en_original: Like you do chores now.
records.en_auxiliary: Like you do chores now.
records.en: Like you do chores now.

records.jp: えへへ……
records.en_original: Eheheh...
records.en_auxiliary: Eheheh...
records.en: Eheheh...

records.jp: 恋人ロボかな
records.en_original: A robot boyfriend, maybe?
records.en_auxiliary: A robot boyfriend, maybe?
records.en: A romantic-partner robot, maybe.

records.jp: でかける時は「行ってらっしゃい。洗濯物は<CR>干しておくね」って言ってくれて
records.en_original: When I leave the house, it'll say, "Have a good day! Don't worry, I'll hang up the laundry."
records.en_auxiliary: When I leave the house, it'll say, "Have a good day! Don't worry, I'll hang up the laundry."
records.en: When I go out, it would say, “Have a good day.<CR>I'll hang the laundry out for you.”

records.jp: 帰ってきたら「お帰りなさい。ご飯できてるよ」って<CR>言ってくれるの
records.en_original: And when I come home, it'll say, "Welcome back! Dinner's ready!"
records.en_auxiliary: And when I come home, it'll say, "Welcome back! Dinner's ready!"
records.en: And when I come home, it would say, “Welcome back.<CR>Dinner is ready.”

records.jp: それ、お手伝いロボとどう違うの？
records.en_original: How is that any different from a helper robot?
records.en_auxiliary: How is that any different from a helper robot?
records.en: How is that any different from a helper robot?

records.jp: 行ってきますのチューしてくれる
records.en_original: It'll kiss me when I leave in the morning!
records.en_auxiliary: It'll kiss me when I leave in the morning!
records.en: It would give me a kiss goodbye.

records.jp: それいる？
records.en_original: You want that?
records.en_auxiliary: You want that?
records.en: You want that?

records.jp: 好きな人からのだったら欲しいでしょ？<CR>伶那さんも
records.en_original: Wouldn't you want someone you like to do that for you, Rena?
records.en_auxiliary: Wouldn't you want someone you like to do that for you, Rena?
records.en: You would want one from someone you liked too, right?<CR>Rena-san?

records.jp: ……わ、私は関係ないでしょ！
records.en_original: Wh-what's this got to do with me?!
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what's this got to do with me?!
records.en: Wh-what's this got to do with me?!

records.jp: ふふ、照れてる。誰のこと考えてたの？
records.en_original: Hehe, why're you being so defensive? Got someone on your mind?
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, why're you being so defensive? Got someone on your mind?
records.en: Hehe, why're you being so defensive? Got someone on your mind?

records.jp: 誰も考えてない！
records.en_original: Of course not!
records.en_auxiliary: Of course not!
records.en: Of course not!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained the <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
